KH-MAN(1)                    User Commands                    KH-MAN(1)

NAME
       kh-man - demonstration program for keys-help

SYNOPSIS
       kh-man [FILE]

DESCRIPTION
       A file viewer. Keys are listed in the KEY BINDINGS section.

KEY BINDINGS
   Navigation
       j, Down    Move down one line.

       k          Move up one line.

   General
       q          This will quit the program immediately. Unsaved changes are lost.

       Ctrl-L     Redraw the screen

       /          Move the cursor to the beginning of the current logical line in the buffer

SEE ALSO
       foo(1)
